description: A substantive, authored analysis or recommendation on a public policy issue, typically issued by a think tank, research institute, government body, or NGO; excludes short news articles, blog posts, press releases, and opinion columns.
examples: Reforming Carbon Pricing in Emerging Economies
The Future of EU Enlargement in the Western Balkans
Strengthening Cybersecurity Resilience in Critical Infrastructure

fields.name: title
fields.description: The main title of the policy paper, usually displayed as a large heading at the top of the page
fields.example: Reforming Carbon Pricing in Emerging Economies

fields.name: authors
fields.description: Authors or contributors, typically shown below the title, sometimes with affiliations and links to bio pages

fields.name: publication_date
fields.description: The official publication or release date, often shown near the title or in a metadata block; commonly written as 'Month DD, YYYY' or 'DD Month YYYY'

fields.name: summary
fields.description: A short abstract or executive summary describing the paper's argument and findings, usually a paragraph or two near the top
fields.example: This paper examines how carbon pricing mechanisms can be adapted to the economic realities of emerging markets, drawing on case studies from Brazil, Indonesia, and South Africa.

fields.name: topics
fields.description: Subject tags or policy areas the paper belongs to, shown as chips or links in a sidebar or header

fields.name: institution
fields.description: The publishing think tank, research center, or organization, often part of the site name or in a 'Published by' line

fields.name: pdf_url
fields.description: Direct link to the full PDF document, typically labeled 'Download PDF', 'Read the full report', or a paper icon

fields.name: page_count
fields.description: Number of pages in the full document, sometimes shown in metadata or in the PDF filename (e.g. report-32pp.pdf)

fields.name: doi
fields.description: Digital Object Identifier assigned to the paper, when applicable; appears in citation blocks or footer metadata
